title: Official Google India Blog: Introducing ‘Bolo’: a new speech based reading-tutor app that helps children learn to read
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Bookmarked: Official Google India Blog: Introducing ‘Bolo’: a new speech based reading-tutor app that helps children learn to read

https://india.googleblog.com/2019/03/introducing-bolo-new-speech-based.html?m=1

h/t to https://kevinmarks.com for sharing this with me. #Literacies have fundementally changed. My children are awash in accessibilitity features. My oldest will not watch TV without close captions and my younger children use screen readers all the time when on the web though the use fades as their skills increase
